reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Definition of principal place of residence
headings.reviewNote: Defines individual principal place of residence as a single county and establishes residence rules for corporations.

headings.title: Venue determination in nontort actions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes county venue rules in actions lacking tort counts based on defendant residence and location of multiple defendants.

headings.title: Inclusion of health care malpractice claims in tort definition
headings.reviewNote: Broadens the statutory definition of tort to include medical and health care malpractice claims under chapter 538.

headings.title: Venue for tort actions with injury occurring within Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Mandates venue in the county where the plaintiff was first injured for tort actions occurring in Missouri.

headings.title: Venue for tort actions with injury occurring outside Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Governs venue selection for tort actions when the plaintiff's first injury occurred outside the state of Missouri.

headings.title: Venue in civil actions commenced by counties
headings.reviewNote: Regulates venue in suits where a county is plaintiff, permitting suit where defendants reside or where service is obtained.

headings.title: Statewide service of process from court of filing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court in which action is filed to issue process executable in any county throughout the state.

headings.title: First injury location in defamation and privacy actions
headings.reviewNote: Defines the location of first injury for defamation or invasion of privacy claims as the county where first published.

headings.title: Temporal determination of venue as of initial injury date
headings.reviewNote: Fixes the time for establishing proper venue as the date upon which the plaintiff sustained the first injury.

headings.title: Ninety-day deemed granted rule for improper venue motions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that improper venue motions to dismiss or transfer are deemed granted if not denied within ninety days absent written waiver.

headings.title: Location of injury in wrongful death and consortium claims
headings.reviewNote: Deems the injury location in wrongful death and loss of consortium actions to be where decedent or spouse was first injured.

headings.title: Applicability to for-profit and not-for-profit entities
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that statutory venue rules apply equally regardless of whether a defendant is a for-profit or nonprofit entity.

headings.title: Transfer of venue upon unanimous written party agreement
headings.reviewNote: Requires venue transfer to any county unanimously chosen by all parties by written agreement, with rules for added parties.

headings.title: Location of injury determined by exposure rather than manifestation
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that first injury occurs where trauma or exposure happened rather than where symptoms first manifested.

headings.title: Transfer of improper venue claims and dismissal without prejudice
headings.reviewNote: Mandates transfer of misfiled claims to proper counties, or dismissal without prejudice if no proper Missouri venue exists.

headings.title: Mandatory appellate reversal for erroneous venue transfer denial
headings.reviewNote: Mandates appellate reversal of erroneous denials of venue transfer motions under section* 507.040, 507.050, or 508.010 (*"sections" in original rolls) without Rule 84.13(b) prejudice showing.

headings.title: Residency definitions for domestic and foreign insurance companies
headings.reviewNote: Deems domestic and foreign insurance companies to reside where their registered office is maintained, or in Cole County for foreign insurers without a Missouri registered office.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 17 subsections, original-rolls footnote (*"sections"), cross-references, and Heartland Title (500 S.W.3d 239) annotation; broadened subsection 17 title to include foreign insurers.

headings.title: Applicability date and grandfathering of pending trial settings
headings.reviewNote: Sets February 13, 2019 applicability date for venue statutes and grandfathers certain pending cases set for trial by August 28, 2019.

headings.title: Proceeding in dismissed venue to prevent limitations bar in pending cases
headings.reviewNote: Allows pending actions dismissed for lack of Missouri venue to proceed in that venue if out-of-state claims would be time-barred.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on February 13, 2019 applicability, grandfathered trial settings, and proceeding in dismissed venue to avoid out-of-state limitations bars.

headings.title: Venue options for department of revenue bad check actions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes suits on bad checks written to the department of revenue in Cole County or the county of defendant's residence.

headings.title: Notice of statutory venue election to check issuers
headings.reviewNote: Requires prior notice of statutory venue selection to be provided to individuals issuing returned checks to the department.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on Cole County or residence venue for DOR bad-check suits (with 30-day cure period) and prior venue-election notice.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for judicial disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates grounds for disqualifying a judge of a court of record in a civil suit, including interest, prejudice, or relationship.

headings.title: Grounds for change of venue from county
headings.reviewNote: Identifies statutory grounds for awarding a change of venue from a county, including inhabitant prejudice or undue party influence.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections enumerating causes for judicial disqualification and county change of venue in civil suits.

headings.title: Judicial determination upon notice of venue change application
headings.reviewNote: Directs court action upon sufficient notice, requiring award of change of venue or assignment of another circuit judge.

headings.title: Venue removal for inhabitant prejudice in populous counties
headings.reviewNote: Requires courts in counties over 65,000 to hear evidence and determine inhabitant-prejudice venue applications on the merits when controverted by counter-affidavit.

headings.title: Inapplicability to special venire cases and nonapplying party rights
headings.reviewNote: Exempts causes involving a special venire and grants an automatic change of venue to the non-applying party upon application.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on judicial action after notice, evidentiary hearings on controverted prejudice in counties over 65,000 (corrected subsection 2 note), and special venire exception.

headings.title: Taxation of venue change expenses against applicant
headings.reviewNote: Taxes costs and expenses attending a change of venue against the applying party rather than in the general costs of suit.

headings.title: Transmittal of distributable court costs to transferee county
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that distributable court costs collected in a transferred case be paid to the county to which venue is transferred.

headings.title: Originating county liability for jury selection and service expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires jury selection and service expenses under chapter 494 to be paid by the county in which the case was originally filed.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections on taxing venue change costs to applicant (or losing party on controverted prejudice), transferring county costs, and originating county jury expenses.

headings.title: Grounds for change of venue from Marion County district two
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates grounds for change of venue from district number 2 of the Marion County circuit court based on local prejudice or influence.

headings.title: Venue transfer to district one or other circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes transfer of cases from district 2 to any circuit court, including district number 1 of the Marion County circuit court.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on change of venue from Marion County circuit court district number 2 based on Mason and Miller township prejudice or influence.

headings.title: Authority to award change of venue to Marion County district two
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any circuit court, including Marion County district 1, to award a change of venue to district number 2.

headings.title: Certification and transmittal from district one to district two
headings.reviewNote: Governs certification and transfer procedures when a change of venue is ordered from district 1 to district 2 in Marion County.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on awarding changes of venue to Marion County circuit court district number 2 and certification/transmittal from district number 1.
